Young people are increasingly skeptical of the state pension's future, leading them to prioritize private savings over immediate consumption due to fears of a future fiscal collapse.

This is a classic case of systemic strain. As the ratio of retirees to workers shifts, the burden on the state increases, forcing individuals to adopt self-reliant strategies to mitigate future uncertainty.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
